description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner. The company is seeking a Salesforce Developer to support enterprise Salesforce implementations by gathering requirements, configuring and developing scalable solutions, building integrations and user experiences, and supporting testing, deployment, maintenance, and production issue resolution.
Salesforce developer building declarative and Apex solutions, Lightning components, integrations, and business-process automations

Responsibilities:
• Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions
• Configure and customize Salesforce using declarative tools, including Flows, Dynamic Forms, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, and Lightning App Builder
• Design and develop custom solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Salesforce APIs
• Build and enhance Lightning-based user experiences using Salesforce Lightning Experience
• Develop reusable components, automations, and integrations that support business processes and improve user productivity
• Perform unit testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and deployment support for Salesforce applications
• Participate in data migration, data cleansing, and data loading activities using Salesforce data management tools
• Participate in code reviews, solution design sessions, sprint planning, and Agile ceremonies
• Create business process flows, user stories, solution documentation, training materials, and end-user guides
• Support application maintenance, performance optimization, and production issue resolution
• Collaborate with architects, business analysts, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality Salesforce solutions
• Exposure to Salesforce AI capabilities, Agentforce, Data Cloud, Prompt Builder, or Einstein features is a plus
• Nice to Have Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud. Experience with Agentforce, Prompt Builder, or Einstein AI capabilities
• Knowledge of Experience Cloud. Experience with Copado CICD, DevOps Center, GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps pipelines

Requirements:
• Years of Experience 1-3 years
• Experience building custom Salesforce applications using Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC)
• Strong understanding of Salesforce Flow (Record-Triggered, Screen Flows, Scheduled Flows, and Orchestration)
• Experience with Lightning App Builder, Dynamic Forms, Dynamic Actions, Validation Rules, Approval Processes, and Security Model configuration
• Knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud
• Familiarity with Salesforce Data Loader and Data Import tools
• Experience integrating Salesforce with external applications using REST APIs and Platform Events
• Working knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps

Preferred:
• Salesforce Certifications preferred: Salesforce Administrator Platform App Builder Platform Developer I Service Cloud Consultant (preferred)
